en.home_intro: I create visual identities and content that bring ideas to life. When a project calls for it, I also work on web design.
en.home_card_1_desc: Visual identity, logo system and brand guidelines for an NFC ecosystem connecting physical touchpoints to digital experiences.
en.home_card_2_desc: Contemporary gourmet identity with strong typographic harmony, custom packaging, and balanced modern layouts.

en.about_role: Born Graphic Designer and evolved into Visual Designer.
en.about_stats_sub: My primary expertise is rooted in Graphic & Visual Design. Web Development, cultural interests, and international adaptability complete my creative profile.

en.hobby_fashion_desc: A genuine love for dressing well, streetwear aesthetics, textures, and curated visual presence.
en.hobby_cinema_desc: Obsessed with cinematography, visual direction, lighting compositions, and directorial storytelling.
en.hobby_music_desc: Constant sonic explorer; music sets the rhythm and emotional backdrop for every creative session.
en.hobby_travel_desc: Eager explorer of foreign cultures, architecture, and perspectives that constantly renew my creative outlook.
en.journey_sub: From self-taught experiments to streetwear and packaging for Italian gourmet brands.
en.journey_01_title: From Hospitality Studies to Digital Design
en.journey_01_text: I began studying at IPSAR Cavalcanti in San Giovanni a Teduccio, initially aiming for a career in fine dining. Internships helped me realise that cooking was a personal passion. My interest in design had started at ten: using Photoshop in gaming communities, I discovered an instinct for composition and visual aesthetics.
en.journey_02_text: After graduating, I spent four months on Erasmus in Lithuania. Living independently in a multicultural setting strengthened my adaptability and English. That experience sparked my passion for travel and discovering new cultures, which continue to enrich my creative perspective and develop my written and spoken English at B1/B2 level.
en.journey_03_text: I started sharing digital portraits and artwork on Instagram, including unpaid projects, to refine my technique and gain visibility. Paid commissions followed: visuals and cover art for emerging and established musicians, including Laioung and Blair. To strengthen my technical skills and working methods, I completed an advanced course in advertising design.
en.journey_04_text: With two partners, I founded Exxxplicit and led its visual direction, from screen-printing files and packaging to digital communication. Its aesthetic, rooted in emotion and intimacy, generated organic engagement and repeated sell-outs. Although differing visions brought the project to an end, it gave me practical experience in production and independent brand building, from concept to finished product.
en.journey_05_text: After Exxxplicit, I worked with a former partner on Tokko (@tokko__it), a brand bringing Italian gourmet food to domestic and European markets. I handled packaging, labelling, photography and Instagram editorial direction, building a consistent visual identity that highlighted the authenticity and gourmet appeal of Made in Italy.
en.journey_06_text: To support my independence and remain self-sufficient, I dedicated five years to clothing retail. This chapter instilled invaluable lessons in professional work ethic, customer psychology, and operational resilience. In parallel, I proactively oversaw the store’s social presence and graphic materials, introducing contemporary, elevated design standards against conventional local retail norms. Today, backed by real-world discipline, verified branding expertise, front-end development foundations, and an insatiable drive for excellence, I am actively seeking a dedicated creative role within a forward-thinking design studio or agency.
en.extra_6: BRAND IDENTITIES. DIGITAL EXPERIENCES. VISUAL CULTURE.
en.extra_17: Specialized in crafting brand identities, editorial visuals, and impactful aesthetics. Web development is my added value to translate visual concepts into functional interfaces.
en.extra_20: Comprehensive identity systems designed with careful attention to typography, storytelling, and visual consistency.
en.extra_21: Complete visual identity, logo design system, and brand guidelines for an NFC-driven ecosystem connecting everyday physical touchpoints to instant digital interactions.
en.extra_22: Full brand identity, logo design guidelines, social media advertising campaigns, and mobile e-commerce UI mockups for an Italian gourmet food brand.
en.extra_23: Complete visual identity project developed with attention to visual coherence, distinct tone of voice, typography system, and brand aesthetic.
en.extra_27: A curated selection of poster designs, editorial explorations, and visual arts.
en.extra_30: Frontend implementations developed to give interactive life to design layouts.
en.extra_31: Development of my personal portfolio, focused on UI/UX, smooth animations, and responsive design.
en.extra_32: A personal movie catalog built with a focus on visual storytelling, clean UI, and a smooth, fully responsive user experience. Designed to showcase curated films divided by genre with an intuitive browsing flow.
en.extra_35: A comprehensive brand identity system designed for a contactless ecosystem powered by NFC technology. Built around simplicity, direct connectivity, and minimal aesthetics, bridging physical interactions with seamless digital experiences.
en.extra_36: A brand identity project developed with a focus on visual consistency, custom typography, packaging design, and contemporary gourmet aesthetics.
en.extra_37: A bold streetwear brand identity crafted with strong emphasis on visual consistency, raw typographic layout, merchandising mockups, and consistent art direction.
en.extra_40: My professional background, ready to explore.
en.extra_43: Updated CV and original training certificates.

Dall'Istituto Alberghiero alla Vocazione Digitale

Ho iniziato gli studi all'IPSAR Cavalcanti di San Giovanni a Teduccio, pensando a un futuro nell'alta ristorazione. Gli stage mi hanno aiutato a capire che la cucina era una passione personale. Il mio interesse per la grafica, invece, era nato già a dieci anni: usavo Photoshop nelle community di gaming, scoprendo un'attitudine per la composizione e l'estetica visiva.

02 / Apertura Internazionale

Erasmus in Lituania & Indipendenza Culturale

Dopo il diploma ho trascorso quattro mesi in Erasmus in Lituania. Vivere in autonomia in un contesto multiculturale ha rafforzato la mia capacità di adattamento e il mio inglese. Da lì è nata la passione per i viaggi e il confronto con nuove culture: esperienze che arricchiscono la mia visione creativa e il mio inglese scritto e parlato, di livello B1/B2.

03 / I Primi Passi nel Settore

Ritratti, Gavetta & Copertine Musicali

Ho iniziato condividendo artwork e ritratti digitali su Instagram, anche gratuitamente, per affinare la tecnica e farmi conoscere. Sono poi arrivate le prime commissioni: visual e cover art per artisti emergenti e affermati, tra cui Laioung e Blair. Per consolidare le mie competenze e acquisire un metodo di lavoro, ho frequentato un corso avanzato in grafica pubblicitaria.

04 / Il Progetto Moda

La Nascita di Exxxplicit & I Sold-Out

Con due soci ho fondato Exxxplicit, curandone la direzione visiva: file per la serigrafia, packaging e comunicazione digitale. L'estetica, legata a sentimento e intimità, ha generato coinvolgimento organico e ripetuti sold-out. Il progetto si è concluso per divergenze di visione, lasciandomi un'esperienza concreta nella gestione della produzione e nella costruzione di un brand indipendente, dall'idea al prodotto finale.

05 / Branding Agroalimentare & Export

L'Esperienza Tokko.it & Il Packaging Gourmet

Dopo Exxxplicit ho collaborato con un precedente socio allo sviluppo di Tokko (@tokko__it), brand dedicato alle eccellenze agroalimentari italiane per i mercati nazionali ed europei. Ho curato packaging, etichettatura, fotografia e linea editoriale Instagram, costruendo un'identità visiva coerente e valorizzando l'autenticità e l'estetica gourmet del Made in Italy.
